text.p: PowerTel USA Inc said it signed a binding letter of intent to acquire various shares and assets from Theme Publishing and Communications Group for $4.0 million in cash, common stock and preferred shares.
Revenues for Theme were about $10.7 million for 1996 with net profit in the six percent range.
It also said it set a one-for-six reverse split of its class A common stock, effective January 31.
The assets being purchased from the Theme stockholders include video and CD duplication and electronic publishing services for financial institutions as well as a contract publishing group.
PowerTel said the acquisitions are expected to boost revenues to about $15.0 million during 1997.
The Theme acquisition is expected to be completed by February 15. After the reverse split and acquisition PowerTel will have about four million class A shares.
PowerTel changed its name on January 3 from Nevada Energy Co Inc NNRGA.O.
